indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CourseStoreNotice_pkey" ON public."CourseStoreNotice" USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX "CourseStoreNotice_storeId_handledAt_startsAt_idx" ON public."CourseStoreNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "handledAt", "startsAt")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CourseStoreNotice_storeId_subjectKey_key" ON public."CourseStoreNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "subjectKey")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "DigitalManagerNotice_pkey" ON public."DigitalManagerNotice" USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "DigitalManagerNotice_storeId_eventKey_key" ON public."DigitalManagerNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "eventKey")
CREATE INDEX "DigitalManagerNotice_store_handled_idx" ON public."DigitalManagerNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "handledAt" DESC, id) WHERE ("handledAt" IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX "DigitalManagerNotice_store_pending_created_idx" ON public."DigitalManagerNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "createdAt" DESC, id) WHERE ("handledAt" IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "SteamfootStoreNotice_pkey" ON public."SteamfootStoreNotice" USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "SteamfootStoreNotice_storeId_bookingId_key" ON public."SteamfootStoreNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "bookingId")
CREATE INDEX "SteamfootStoreNotice_storeId_handledAt_startsAt_idx" ON public."SteamfootStoreNotice" USING btree ("storeId", "handledAt", "startsAt")
